body:
Runner lesson for Windows FULLs (WinB): before launching a TermAl FULL or a focused run that creates Git fixtures, check that the worktree's repository-local `.tmp` path is at most 67 UTF-8 bytes. src/test_temp_root.rs:72 panics on deeper fixture roots, to keep the suite's Git fixtures within Git's Windows path limits. Every fixture-using test then fails with "test fixture directory … is N bytes long, more than the 67 …; use a shallower checkout". That is a runner path-selection error, not a product failure, and it does not count as a valid gate.
Source: the w-e8c7 E2n WinB repeat test-bc1b3d30 on 2026-11-25 (relay #95) used C:\GitHub\Personal\TermAl\.tmp\j\e8c7-full-29ad6709-winb-repeat1\wt\.tmp (72 bytes) and got 719 path-guard failures out of 8571 tests. Use short worktree names, such as .tmp/j/<item4>-<commit8>/wt, and check the length before launch.
